_: The photo manifest. One row per photo the site uses: slug (the name the code asks for), file (the original in --src), and alt text in both locales. The originals live OUTSIDE the repo (~/Desktop/osppy-fotos by default) and .gitignore blocks *.jpg under public/photos. Run: node scripts/optimize-photos.mjs [--src <dir>]. No credits file: the Unsplash and Pexels licenses ask for attribution and do not require it; the author slug and the photo id stay in `file`, which is where traceability belongs. v6 (2026-09-08, HQA-D137): the site is largely photographs, all of them licensed bank photos of real people in real work settings; NO model-generated image enters (foundation §9): the v5 `hero` row (a Gemini image) is kept here only until FASE 4 prunes this manifest to the v6 rows, and it is not rendered. Each v6 photo is approved by the operator one by one on the prototype (gate 3).
